story.origin.forest: Born in the shade of an ancient forest.
story.origin.hills: Born in the kilns of the red hills.
story.origin.mountains: Born in a village clinging to the mountains.
story.origin.swamp: Born on a stilt house in the middle of the swamp.
story.origin.desert: Born in a caravan crossing the desert.
story.origin.tundra: Born at the edge of the tundra, where the wind never stops.
story.pastJob.bouncer: Spent years as a bouncer at an inn.
story.pastJob.lumberjack: Chopped wood for a mountain sawmill.
story.pastJob.bookmark: Spent twenty years as a bookmark in a library.
story.pastJob.cartographer: Drew maps for a forgetful baron.
story.pastJob.lamplighter: Lit the lamps of a city that barely slept.
story.pastJob.peddler: Peddled leaky pots door to door.
story.pastJob.auctioneer: Ran the auctions at the fish market.
story.pastJob.beekeeper: Kept wild bees, without a veil.
story.pastJob.goatherd: Led mountain goats along impossible paths.
story.event.well: Fell down a well and climbed out the next day.
story.event.fire: Survived a fire with one singed corner.
story.event.shipwreck: Shipwrecked on an island, swam back home.
story.event.lost: Lost in a forest for a month, learned to find the way.
story.event.duel: Won an insult duel against a bard.
story.event.race: Beat a horse in a race (the horse was lame).
story.event.curse: A witch took away their sleep: they haven't slept since.
story.event.treasure: Found a treasure and lost it the next day.
story.mania.fixes_maps: Corrects everyone's maps, even when nobody asked.
story.mania.collects_stones: Collects stones and always carries them along.
story.mania.sings: Always sings the same song, off key.
story.mania.naps: Falls asleep anywhere, even standing up.
story.mania.tuesdays: Never sets off on a Tuesday.
story.mania.talks_to_hat: Talks to their hat, which sometimes answers.
